detail.longDescription: 👋 Hi Fediverse! I'm Jikwang, and I'm building Corvus: a free, open-source reverse proxy with a web application firewall built in. Same easy workflow as Nginx Proxy Manager, plus attack blocking on by default, automatic IP bans, country/path rules, a bot challenge without CAPTCHAs, live traffic and a waiting room for traffic spikes. One Docker container, Apache-2.0, no paid tier. https:// github.com/corvus-gateway/corv us # selfhosted # homelab # opensource # infosec # docker
